title: Coffin Tunnel Portal
description: A surreal circular portal framed by a weathered green mechanical ring adorned with bones, mushrooms, vials, and glowing string lights. Inside the tunnel, numerous ornate blue coffins hang from chains and recede into a glowing purple vortex with radiating light beams, set against a swirling green and purple aurora sky.
prompt: Surreal circular portal with a weathered green metallic frame decorated with scattered bones, mushrooms, glass vials and string lights. Inside a dark tunnel, multiple ornate blue coffins hang from chains in rows, leading toward a glowing purple vortex with radiating light beams. Background shows swirling green and purple aurora sky with misty clouds, in a dark whimsical macabre style.
